summary: This document is the policy wording (terms and conditions) for a bundled two-wheeler motor insurance policy issued by HDFC ERGO General Insurance Company Limited. It outlines the coverage for loss or damage to the insured vehicle (Section I), including specific perils, depreciation rates for parts, exclusions, and conditions for repairs. It defines the Insured’s Declared Value (IDV) and its calculation, including depreciation schedules for total loss claims. Section II covers third-party liability for bodily injury and property damage, subject to policy limits. The document also includes insurer details, customer service information, and regulatory compliance details.
